hook: Black Friday: 3 checks before you buy 🛒
summary: Three quick checks that matter more than the discount.
points: Jump starter: match peak amps to your engine's cold cranking amps (CCA). Rexing 3000A: 3000A peak, $129.99
Video doorbell: check what the cloud storage plan costs. Rexing SDB1: 1080p, 2-year warranty, $49.99
Robot vacuum: does the base wash the mop and refill water? SwitchBot S20 does both, $799.99 (specs-based pick)
offer: Extra 10% at Rexing with code RANKERNEST10.
caveat: Deals change daily in November; prices at time of writing.
